name: WP Google Street View & Google Maps
author: Pagup

sections.description:
Help visitors recognize your location before they arrive. WP Google Street View lets you choose a Google Street View panorama or map, adjust the view in WordPress, and embed it with a shortcode. Update the saved view once to change every page that uses it.

Use it for a storefront, office, venue or other place covered by Google Maps. Street View imagery, including indoor panoramas where available, comes from Google. The plugin does not upload your own 360-degree photographs or create local virtual tours.

What you can do with the free plugin

  • Create saved Street View panoramas or basic Google Maps.
  • Enter an address or coordinates manually, including zero latitude or longitude.
  • Use optional address suggestions or request your browser location while editing.
  • Preview your view, adjust Street View orientation and zoom, then save it.
  • Set map dimensions and reuse a shortcode on multiple pages or more than once on a page.
  • Insert a saved view through the classic editor’s shortcode selector, or paste its shortcode into a Shortcode block.

More control with Pro

Pro adds a synchronized Street View and map, custom marker icons and marker interactions, custom info box content, additional map styles and traffic, transit and bicycle layers. It also includes the existing Local Business structured data settings for the business details you supply.

These options help you present your location and useful information in one place. Structured data does not guarantee search rankings, rich results or inclusion in an AI answer. See WP Google Street View for product information.

Create your first view

  1. Activate the plugin and open WP Google Street View > Settings to save your Google Maps Platform API key.
  2. Add a new view and select Street View or Basic Map. The combined view requires Pro.
  3. Enter an address or latitude and longitude. Suggestions are optional. You can also request your current location using your browser’s permission prompt.
  4. Preview the location. For Street View, adjust the direction and zoom you want visitors to see.
  5. Publish the view and paste its generated [wpgsv id="123"] shortcode into a page or post, replacing 123 with your view’s actual ID.

For a direct coordinate embed, use [wpgsv_map lat="0" lng="0" type="map"] and replace the coordinates with your location. Supported types are street, map and streetmap (combined in Pro; Street View fallback without Pro access).

Edit saved views from WP Google Street View > All items. If a page still shows an older view, clear its page and CDN caches.

Google Maps Platform setup

For production, use a standard browser API key from a Google Cloud project with billing enabled. Follow Google’s setup guide, then enable only the services your site uses:

  • Maps JavaScript API: displays Google maps and Street View at saved coordinates.
  • Geocoding API: searches an address or looks up an address from coordinates.
  • Places API (New): provides optional address suggestions in the editor.

If an older project has Places Legacy enabled, enable Places API (New) to use the modern suggestions. Your saved views and manual fields remain available independently of suggestions. The browser location button does not require Google Geolocation API. Directions API, Routes API and Street View Static API are not prerequisites for this plugin.

Restrict the browser key to the websites and APIs you actually use, including an administration or staging domain only when needed. A browser key is visible in browser requests; restrictions control where it can be used. Do not permanently remove restrictions to resolve an error.

Google also offers a limited Maps Demo Key for prototyping. It is not a production key or evidence that every Street View, Geocoding and Places function is available.

Google usage and billing

Eligible new accounts may receive a one-time US$300 trial credit valid for 90 days under Google’s trial terms. This is separate from monthly free usage allowances for individual Maps Platform products. Charges depend on your services and usage; check Google’s current pricing and monitor your project.

The trial does not automatically become a paid account. Services may stop when the trial or credit expires unless you upgrade. Budget alerts do not automatically cap spending. A plugin licence does not include Google usage charges.

External services

Maps and panoramas are supplied by Google Maps Platform. Displaying a view loads Google resources in the visitor’s browser. Address searches and suggestions send the entered search to Google; the location button requests the browser’s permission and may use Google for reverse address lookup. Review Google’s terms and privacy policy for the service. Configure any consent tooling required for your site separately.

About the publisher

WP Google Street View is developed by Pagup. Product information and resources are available at wpstreetview.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WP Google Street View from WordPress, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Open WP Google Street View > Settings and configure your Google API key and the services you need.
  3. Create and publish a view. Insert its shortcode into a page or post.
sections.faq:
Do I need Places to display a saved view?

No. Maps JavaScript API renders saved coordinates. Geocoding API is needed for address lookup; Places API (New) is needed only for suggestions. You can enter and save coordinates without selecting a suggestion.

Can I upload my own panorama or build a local virtual tour?

This version displays Google’s imagery. It does not include a panorama upload tool or a local scene editor. Street View availability depends on Google’s coverage of the location.

Why is the preview unavailable?

Check your network connection, enabled APIs, billing and website restrictions in the Google project. The editor distinguishes map availability, address lookup and optional suggestions. It waits up to 15 seconds for Maps; if loading fails, your manual fields remain usable. Use Preview again after correcting the configuration.

Can another plugin load Google Maps?

WP Google Street View reuses a recognized Google loader already requested through WordPress, including a required dependency or a script already printed. Merely registering an unused script does not activate it. The other plugin’s key, language, libraries and callback stay unchanged.

Asynchronous Maps availability is checked for up to 15 seconds. Scripts inserted independently after the plugin chooses its loader, consent delays beyond that interval and every optimizer configuration cannot all be coordinated by this check. Test the combination used by your site.

Why does a custom info box show the address after an update?

Clear page and CDN caches so the page includes the current info box data. When a site blocks the inline data script, the safe fallback is the address as text. Text stored as HTML entities stays text.

Does the plugin guarantee better local rankings?

No. Maps help visitors find and recognize your location. Pro’s Local Business settings describe the business information you provide; they do not guarantee search or AI visibility.

1.1.16

  • Requires WordPress 5.6.2 or later and PHP 7.4 or later.
  • Make Places New suggestions optional, preserve the latest manual input, reuse active Google loaders, handle delayed Maps availability, and keep secure info boxes aligned with each view. Update setup guidance and translations.

1.1.15

  • Security hardening of front-end map and info box rendering. After updating, clear your page and CDN caches so the update takes full effect and custom info box content displays correctly.
